_comment_kafka_mapping: In structured mode, this entire JSON object is the Kafka record value. In binary mode, specversion/type/source/id/time would move to Kafka record headers.
_comment_idempotency: The 'id' attribute SHOULD equal the producer's idempotency key when retry semantics are required.
_comment_versioning: The 'type' attribute encodes major version (v1); minor changes do not alter the type URI.
